name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.32.2: an empty transaction search now says what the machine actually holds, instead of just 'nothing found'. Hunting 8626020716's sales from the wrong-clock outage returned nothing on both timestamp bases, which is ambiguous between three different problems needing three different next steps: the window is wrong, the timestamp column is wrong, or the machine has no such records at all. Every response now carries an available block - settlement count with the full span of both closedAt and receivedAt, and order count with the span of createTime - and the empty state renders it. If a machine turns out to have no settlements at all, the panel says so and warns that its sales arrive as order lines, which carry only createTime: a sale written under a wrong clock is filed under the wrong date there and nothing on that table can reveal it, so the only way to match it is on amount against the card processor. Cumulative over v6.32.1.
